sahneler.metin: Returning from the North Pole, the airship Italia crashed onto the ice.
The impact killed one man and left survivors stranded.
The envelope drifted off with six more crew, who were never found.
Ice and headwinds had made the ship heavy.
It lost height and hit the pack ice.
Survivors camped for weeks in a red tent.
Roald Amundsen died flying to search for them.
It became one of the first large international air rescues.

aciklama:
Airship Italia crashed on the Arctic pack ice. The cause: loss of lift and control from ice accumulation and weather, with the envelope carried away after impact.

#shorts #engineering #aviation
